svg.title: TX card cage side and front
svg.text: SIDE (section, seen from the left wall): back wall and pole left, lid right
FRONT (from the lid, glands down): left wall (card block) left
BQ25798EVM parts above the board (J6, J3, J5 past its edges)
glands in the bottom wall: 5 PG-7, 2 PG-9 (right column), no spare
base / lid seam (Yb 117): lid tray beyond

TX stack r3 in the printed PETG base (enclosure 4, 120 deep) under the #905 lid, hanging long side up, to scale 3.2 px/mm; inside 121 x 167.5 x 140 mm (lid interface: L2 and the rim ring's fit [TBD-MEASURE])
Blue: moulded cage features. Red slabs: cards. Tan: backplane. Dashed: plug keep-outs. Grey: corner blocks, gland nuts, mounting flanges; the lid's channel wall and bosses above the seam.
Shelves bottom to top: the pack, the BQ25798EVM (90 x 90, J8 toward the lid), B4, B2, B1, B3; all slide toward the back. Glands in the bottom wall; cables rise in the right column.
